name: חֲוִילָה
summary: The land around which the Pishon flows, where gold is found; also the land at one end of the territory where Ishmael’s sons settled. The tables of nations name a son of Cush and a son of Joktan Havilah. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The Pishon flows around כָּל אֶרֶץ הַחֲוִילָה, “the whole land of Havilah.”
Ishmael’s sons settle “from Havilah to Shur.”
Havilah among the sons of Cush.
Havilah among the sons of Joktan, beside Ophir.

note: Moved from the former word entry `7eawiylaah`. The old root key חוילה used the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain. TIPNR’s two other places and two persons of this spelling are added; whether the lands are one region, or named from the men, is not shown.
